summary: The user stopped the experiment after the mechanism probe and orthogonal-gain-1 arm provided sufficient evidence. Orthogonal sqrt(2) amplified signals and gradients dramatically; gain 1 passed both partial-recovery thresholds. Depth scaling stopped at 302/384 updates without final evaluation, and zero-last plus SkipInit never started.

observed: Across 16 parameter seeds on the same 32 observations, orthogonal-sqrt2 produced 26.2468x Glorot encoder RMS, 27.5101x encoder JVP RMS gain and 776.2791x synthetic PPO global gradient L2.

Changing only the orthogonal gain from sqrt(2) to 1 reduced those ratios to 1.5875x, 1.6523x and 2.3879x while returning the last residual branch-to-skip ratio from 1.0570 to 0.5300, nearly the Glorot value 0.5380.
Zero-last and SkipInit made every probed residual branch initially zero, but sqrt(2) initialization outside the residual branches still left encoder/JVP/gradient scale above Glorot.
interpretation: The zero-update evidence supports the preregistered amplification mechanism and identifies sqrt(2) gain, rather than orthogonality alone, as the main tested source of the initial scale gap.
The probe does not establish which mitigation improves trained policy quality; all four training arms remain unconditional.

Orthogonal gain 1 recovered 53.3333% of both retained gaps and passed the preregistered midpoint thresholds, but remained below the Glorot anchor; it is a partial mitigation rather than a complete recovery.
not_established: Whether gain 1 fully matches Glorot across multiple training seeds.
Whether depth scaling, zero-last or SkipInit improve final CoinRun sample efficiency because those arms did not obtain comparable final evaluations.
Whether any result generalizes across seeds, games, encoders or PPO implementations.
decision: Stop the remaining mitigation arms at the user's request and retain the incomplete-arm evidence.
Use the completed probe plus gain-1 result only as an internal, architecture-specific conclusion.
Do not present unrun zero-last or SkipInit arms as negative results.
